meta.title: California Legislature: who represents each district
meta.stamp: Sitting members as of Nov. 12, 2026. Incoming members as listed by MultiState on Nov. 24; unofficial until results are certified.

sources.label: Sitting members.
sources.text: Assembly names, parties and Capitol suites are from the Assembly's own member roster as of Nov. 12, 2026; Assembly district offices are from the Assembly District Office Roster dated Nov. 2, 2026. Senate names, Capitol suites, district offices and emails are from the Secretary of State's California Roster 2026, checked against Open States (updated Nov. 5, 2026); that roster was published early in the year, so a few Senate office details may have changed, and each senator's own site is linked. Assembly emails are from Open States, since the official rosters do not list them. Three senators' emails are left out because the sources disagree.

sources.label: Incoming members.
sources.text: Winners are as listed on MultiState's California 2026 results page on Nov. 24, 2026, read against Brownstein's Nov. 10 summary. Results are unofficial until certified. Races with no recorded winner are marked not yet called, and two Assembly races where the sources name different winners are marked unconfirmed. Contact details shown for a seat that is changing hands are the current office's; new members' details are published after they are sworn in.

sources.label: Voting record measures.
sources.text: CalChamber figures are from the California Chamber of Commerce's Best Business Votes 2025 (Nov. 7, 2025): the share of counted votes in accord with the Chamber's position, grouped in the Chamber's own tiers. Courage Scores are from Courage California's All-Stars and Hall of Shame pages as copied on Nov. 17, 2026, which list only the members at each end of its scale. Progressive Caucus membership is the Assembly's caucus roster as of Nov. 17, 2026; the caucus's Senate members are not listed there. These describe sitting members and are not official labels.

sources.label: Map.
sources.text: District lines are the U.S. Census Bureau's 2022 state legislative district boundaries, which are the districts drawn in 2021. Counties listed for each district are worked out from those boundaries.
